name: Lint Check

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, release/*]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  # Cancel only on PR branches. Two merges landing close together share one group
  # on main, and cancelling there leaves the earlier commit with no test verdict.
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      targets: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.targets }}
      python: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.python }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check for file changes
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            frontend:
              - 'apps/frontend/**'
              - 'ee/frontend/**'
            docs:
              - 'docs/src/**'
              - 'docs/content/**'
              - 'docs/scripts/**'
            sdk:
              - 'sdk/**'
              - 'ruff.toml'
            backend:
              - 'apps/backend/**'
              - 'ruff.toml'
            penelope:
              - 'penelope/**'
              - 'ruff.toml'
            migrations:
              - 'apps/backend/src/rhesis/backend/alembic/versions/**'
            skill:
              - 'skills/rhesis/**'
              - 'scripts/skill/**'
            kubernetes:
              - 'kubernetes/**'
              - 'charts/rhesis/**'
              - 'scripts/check-k8s-secret-overlap.sh'

      - name: Resolve lint targets
        id: resolve
        env:
          CHANGED: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && '["backend","sdk","penelope","frontend","docs","skill","kubernetes"]' || steps.filter.outputs.changes }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "Changed areas: $CHANGED"
          echo "targets=$CHANGED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          PYTHON=$(jq -nc --argjson changed "$CHANGED" '
            [ {id: "backend",  dir: "apps/backend"},
              {id: "sdk",      dir: "sdk"},
              {id: "penelope", dir: "penelope"} ]
            | map(select(.id as $id | $changed | index($id)))
            | map(.dir)')
          echo "python=$PYTHON" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Python matrix: $PYTHON"

  python:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.python != '[]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        dir: ${{ fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.python) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b # v8.1.0

          enable-cache: true

        run: make lint

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
